messages:
anne: Heads-up — preflight for release r3.4.2 just failed one of the summarizer prompt evals. Deploybot flagged a missing 'sample_signer' approval and blocked promotion. Window closes in ~45m. Who can triage?

deploybot: Deploybot notice: preflight-checks: SUMMARY_EVAL: 1/24 failed -> gate=HOLD. Missing approval: sample_signer. To approve run: `deploybot approve --thread 3254321000 --reason 'manual-risk-ack'`

esther: On it. Which prompt case failed? short summary with numeric lists? I can pull the failing input.

mike: Looks like the regression is on long-list summarization ( > 800 tokens ). Model outputs hallucinate list items. Quick diff suggests tokenization change after quantization tweak.

anne: Noted. We have three options: 1) Hold and rerun expanded eval (30-60m) 2) Manual sign-off to let canary go with tight guardrails 3) Pin to previous model for this change window.

sasha: I prefer hold+rerun if we can finish in time. But if QA needs >45m, we should consider a manual canary with low traffic.

oliver: Operational constraints: canary ramping is configured by releasebot. We can start a 5% canary immediately and watch per-route latency/cost. Rolling back is cheap but will trigger downstream consistency checks.

esther: I pulled the failing examples. Sample set is small — adding 60 targeted long-list items and rerunning should give a clearer signal. I can run that in ~22m if nobody blocks.

mike: If we rerun, please include the quantized variant (q4_2) and float32 baseline. Regression might be quant-specific.

anne: Good call. esther, run the expanded pass including both quant variants. deploybot, can you keep the gate in HOLD and surface results to this thread?

deploybot: Acknowledged. Will rerun on request or post updated results automatically. Current gate remains HOLD.

oliver: Contingency: if eval rerun still fails, propose manual partial rollout plan: 10% canary, restrict summarizer route to EU region only, enable auto-fallback to legacy model on high error rate (>3%).

sasha: @anne @mike @esther please vote: HOLD+RERUN, MANUAL_SIGNOFF+10%_CANARY, or PIN_PREV. Reply with short tag.

mike: HOLD+RERUN :+1:

esther: HOLD+RERUN :eyes:

anne: MANUAL_SIGNOFF+10%_CANARY — product needs releases in the window, but only if we get the route guard in place.

sasha: PIN_PREV — slightly prefer safety but can accept manual canary if ops+qa sign off.

oliver: MANUAL_SIGNOFF+10%_CANARY — ops ok with the restrictions I listed.

anne: Consensus split. Because product needs the window, I'm approving MANUAL_SIGNOFF+10%_CANARY with the following conditions: 1) esther runs the expanded eval immediately and posts results in this thread 2) canary limited to 10% and EU-only 3) auto-fallback to previous model if route error >= 3% for 5m 4) deploybot logs the approval reason.

deploybot: Action: manual-approve recorded by anne. Canary policy applied: 10% EU-only. Auto-fallback monitor set: error_threshold=3%, window=300s.

qa-bot: QA alert subscribed: will post evaluation diffs when esther's run completes.

esther: Kicking off expanded eval now (esther -> eval-run-4598). ETA ~18m. Will post failures summary.

mike: I'll keep monitoring for quant-specific regressions. If esther's run shows quant-only issues, we can hotpatch quant profile to q3 for the summarizer route.

anne: Thanks all. @sasha please ping infra if we need rollback. I'll update release notes with the manual exception and risk acknowledgment.

sasha: Will do. I'll also file a short post-release follow-up to decide long-term: revert the quant change or tighten prompt templates.

deploybot: Status update (automated): eval-run-4598 started by esther at ts=3254321800, expected finish ~3254322880. Gate remains MANUAL_SIGNOFF active.

anne: Thread summary: manual sign-off granted by product with strict canary and auto-fallback. esther rerunning expanded eval; results to determine next steps (hotpatch quant or rollback).
